scoring_justification: Barrier ordering, barrier heights, and bond-length deviations are recomputed from the raw energy and geometry files; the paper provides explicit crystallographic reference values and a known overall ΔG.

outputs.description: Relative Gibbs free energy profile (kcal/mol) referenced to separated reactants.

schema.description: Multi-frame XYZ; five frames in order: reactants, ts1_cycloaddition, intermediate (4a-Sn), ts2_insertion, product (2a-Sn).

outputs.description: Optimized Cartesian coordinates of all five stationary points.

output_contract.notes: The DFT calculation is computationally intensive; the solving agent is expected to use a suitable quantum chemistry code on external HPC resources.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference bond lengths (Si-P, Si-N, Si-Sn for 1a-Sn; Si-P, Si-N, Si-C3, Sn-C4, C3-C4 for 2a-Sn) and energetic ordering rules
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's reported crystallographic values and energy profile description; ordering rules inferred from the paper's description of the two-step mechanism.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported values and the expected physical ordering of a two-step exergonic reaction profile.

steps.description: Verify energies JSON exists and has required fields.
Verify XYZ file exists and contains five correctly labelled frames.
Score relative Gibbs free energy profile: ordering (TS above minima), barrier heights < 15 kcal/mol, overall ΔG close to -5.8 kcal/mol.
Compare key bond lengths of reactant 1a-Sn and product 2a-Sn to crystallographic reference values within ±0.05 Å.
